strategyThesis: In 2027, build a second leadership layer to remove founder dependency and unlock client expansion, while deliberately deferring adjacent services and price increases. Decide by end of January between external hire, internal promotion, or scope reduction, with a 90-day delegation pilot to validate the path.

strategicAlternatives.name: External hire
strategicAlternatives.whereToPlay: Hire a senior leader externally to own delivery and client expansion.
strategicAlternatives.howToWin: Bring in proven capability and speed, reducing founder dependency quickly.

tradeoffs.text: Faster capability but higher cost and cultural integration risk.
tradeoffs.label: ai_inference

strategicAlternatives.name: Internal promotion and coaching
strategicAlternatives.whereToPlay: Promote an internal candidate and provide coaching to grow into the role.
strategicAlternatives.howToWin: Preserve culture and leverage existing relationships, but requires development time.

tradeoffs.text: Lower cost and cultural fit but slower ramp-up and capability risk.
tradeoffs.label: ai_inference

strategicAlternatives.name: Reduce service scope before delegating
strategicAlternatives.whereToPlay: Narrow the service offering to make delegation manageable.
strategicAlternatives.howToWin: Focus on core strengths, enabling effective delegation and reducing complexity.

tradeoffs.text: Increased focus but potential revenue loss from dropped services.
tradeoffs.label: ai_inference
